messages: Marta: Quick sync 0 min: Create Pool form in the dashboard got denser due to collapsible advanced settings. Need a pattern decision: 1) show inline errors immediately (on blur) for fields inside collapsed sections? 2) required marker style for condensed rows on narrow view (mobile/responsive) 1px asterisk vs full 'Required' label? 3) delete confirm patterns when deleting from list view vs detail page (typed confirm vs checkbox vs undo). Priya: For collapsed sections, inline errors that are out-of-viewport are problematic. We should surface a top summary that links to the collapsed section and also set the section to open on submit fail. Inline errors still OK for visible fields. Omar: Agreed. Also for mobile, prefer concise indicators: use a small asterisk visually but include offscreen text "Required" for SRs. On larger screens show explicit 'Required' text in dense forms only if space permits. Tess: My vote: immediate format validation on blur for fields like `quota` and `URL`. Required-field errors should be shown only after submit attempt. If an error lives in a collapsed section, expand that section and focus the first invalid field. Lee: Implementation notes: make the top summary anchor to the input with `element.focus()` and `scrollIntoView({block: 'center'})`. For SR: announce "Form submission failed. Section X expanded. Focus moved to first error." Use `aria-live="assertive"` for the banner. Marta: Good point about anchors. I worry about spamming SRs with every blur. Which `aria-live` level do we use for inline errors? polite vs assertive? Priya: Inline ephemeral format errors -> `aria-live="polite"`. Submission banner and collapsed-section expansion -> `aria-live="assertive"`. That way we avoid interrupting while user is typing. Omar: Delete flows: in list view we show a compact confirm modal with checkbox + reason dropdown and undo toast. On the detail page where the user expects more gravity, we use typed-confirm for pools tagged `prod` or with live deployments >0. The typed token should be the pool id, monospace. Tess: Copy suggestion for typed confirm modal: Permanently delete pool "edge-canary"? This will remove data and active deployments. Type the pool ID to confirm: `edge-canary` Show a small row: "Active deployments: 3 | Machines: 8" above the input. Marta: Small UX nit: if the user mistypes, show a subtle inline error and keep the typed text so they can correct. Don't auto-clear. Also show a small hint for keyboard users: "Press Enter to confirm" when the typed token matches. Lee: Accessibility nit: any visible asterisk must have "Required" after it. Always set `aria-required="true"` on required inputs. Link error message with `aria-describedby="fieldname-error"`. Use `role="alert"` for errors inserted after submit. Priya: For collapsed sections, add a compact indicator in the section header when errors exist (red dot + count), and include keyboard affordance to expand (Enter/Space). Screen reader should announce "Section X: 2 errors". Omar: UX timing rules proposal: format checks on blur, required/missing after submit attempt, collapsed-section errors cause auto-expand on submit with focus-first-invalid. Bulk delete from list uses checkbox + reason + undo toast; destructive/production uses typed-confirm. Tess: One more edge case: multi-select fields inside collapsed sections. If an error is about selecting at least one item, treat that like required and wait until submit to show unless user interacts with the control. Marta: Action items I captured: 1) Spec update: format validation on blur, required errors after first submit; 2) Collapsed sections: show top summary on submit fail, expand sections with errors and focus-first-invalid; 3) Required marker: prefer `Required` text for roomy layouts, fallback to asterisk + offscreen text on dense/mobile; 4) Delete flows: list view = compact checkbox modal + undo, detail page = typed-confirm for prod/non-empty pools; 5) Dev: implement `aria-describedby`, `role=alert`, `aria-live` usage (polite for inline, assertive for banners), and section error counters. Lee: I'll add code snippets and a small focus-first-invalid util in the component lib. Will ping for review. Priya: I'll mock the collapsed-section banner + screen-reader announcements and test on VoiceOver. Marta: Thanks team. I'll open the PR with copy + a11y snippets tomorrow and add test cases for mobile narrow view. design-bot: Summary note added to docs/design/create-pool-collapsible.md (draft).
